_comment: Your bulletin sources. Fill in 'url' and 'how' with the real way in once known. Set enabled=false to hide one. Never put passwords here.

sources.name: ALLDATA Europe
how: Open ALLDATA Europe and select the vehicle (registration or VIN if supported, else make/model/engine).
Look in the vehicle's technical service bulletins / known issues section and search for the fault code.

sources.name: Autodata (Europe)
how: Open Autodata and select the vehicle.
Look in the vehicle's technical bulletins / known fixes section and search for the fault code.

sources.name: HaynesPro (Europe)
how: Open HaynesPro and select the vehicle.
Look in the vehicle's technical bulletins / known issues section and search for the fault code.
